text:
Ava Morgan: FYI I pushed a first draft of the Deploy Pathways one-pager to drive enterprise conversations — focuses on security / SLAs / deploy modes. Need quick check on: messaging, benchmark hook, webinar tie-ins, and inbound routing form fields. Pinged cc: @Miguel @Sasha @Evan @Priya
Miguel Chen: Saw it, looks promising. I can add crisp SLA bullets and a tiny table for comparatives.
Sasha Patel: I’ll tighten the security section (KMS/HSM, SOC2, VPC). Quick Q: can we use the phrase 'customer-managed control plane' or prefer 'private control plane'?
Ava Morgan: Use 'customer-managed control plane' — clearer for procurement/readers. Keep it short.
Evan Li: I’ll draft a 90s webinar hook + benchmark narrative. Thinking: lead with a real workload line (customer-conversational + embedding search) and a one-line cost/latency stat. Can we use percentage improvements or do we need exact numbers cleared?
Miguel Chen: Percentages are fine if we footnote methodology. For SLA bullets I’m thinking one-liners: Hosted: 99.9% uptime, Dedicated: 99.95% uptime, Private: per-contract. Add latency SLOs for 512-token median p95.
Priya Kapoor: For inbound routing I recommend these fields: company, contact, deployment interest (hosted/dedicated/private), security must-haves, timeline, preferred region, estimated qps, trial request. Tagging rules in HubSpot: deploy_mode, security_flag, sla_priority.
Priya Kapoor: Sample routing rule (for engineering handoff):
```
if deploy_mode == 'private' or security_flag == 'high': assign -> AE + Solutions + Security SME
else if deploy_mode == 'dedicated': assign -> AE + Solutions
else: assign -> self-serve nurture flow
```
Sasha Patel: Also add compliance packages callout: SOC2, ISO27001, FedRAMP (in process). Call out data residency and audit logs explicitly. Short bullet about KMS/HSM integration too.
Ava Morgan: We need a concise benchmark narrative paragraph for the one-pager: setup, workload, baseline vs Redwood numbers, and a placeholder for a small graph. Keep it punchy for exec readers.
Evan Li: Draft idea: "Benchmark on e-comm chat + embedding lookup: same API, optimized runtime -> 30% lower per-token cost and ~2x throughput vs baseline configuration. See methodology footnote." I’ll verify numbers and add a 2-line methodology note.
Miguel Chen: Adding a mini SLA table snippet for the one-pager (short): Hosted — 99.9% uptime; Dedicated — 99.95%; Private — per-contract. Also a line about automatic fallback to compatible model variants during capacity events.
Priya Kapoor: Once copy final, I’ll wire the inbound form and automation: campaign=deploy-pathways, form=/forms/deploy-pathways, hubspot_tags=[deploy_mode,security_flag,sla_priority]. I’ll add the Webhook to create lead + assign to queue.
Sasha Patel: :thumbsup: I can do final copy edit and compress to one pager. I’ll need Evan's benchmark text by Thursday EOD to finish.
Evan Li: On it — I’ll drop the draft benchmark + small chart asset by Wed midday.
launch-bot: Reminder: marketing-campaign 'deploy-pathways' kickoff scheduled Thu 10:00. Auto-created form: /forms/deploy-pathways.
Ava Morgan: Perfect. Thanks everyone. I updated the doc with these notes and tagged tasks: Miguel (SLA bullets), Sasha (security copy + final edit), Evan (benchmark), Priya (routing/form + automation). Deadline: EOD Friday for review cycle.
Miguel Chen: Noted. I’ll put the SLA bullets in the doc now.
Priya Kapoor: I’ll prototype the HubSpot fields & workflow today and share screenshots.
Sasha Patel: Will do final pass Friday morning and compress language to fit a single page.
Evan Li: Draft incoming Wed.
Ava Morgan: Great cadence. If anything blocks, flag here. Thanks! :rocket:
